description.en: Pakicetus attocki: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m whole length is artistic assetscale. Thewissen etal2009 Fig9 LEFT composite Pakicetus, not one complete fossil; Fig11 LEFT TWO H-GSP96231 and96623 skulls lack snouts, so full rostrum from Fig9. Long legs, low long narrow skull, high close eyes. Soft body, joint gaps, ears, colors, padding, digits and stance artistic. 2001 restricted article not accessed.
